description: Where the final value of $E is not empty, `$E ∩ tags($x)` uses $x, which an alternative lacks. The loader finds this once $E has its final value, and reports it at the definition, as the reader reports such an error (engine §2, §9).
grammar:
%const $E B ∖ B
%rule text A | $x(A)
%tags Y ∪ ($E ∩ tags($x))
%redefine-const $E B
